Uttarakhand's Kanwar Yatra 2026 to Have Stricter Rules

The upcoming Kanwar Yatra 2026 in Uttarakhand will have stricter rules, including a maximum height of 10 feet for the DJ and 12 feet for its width. The new guidelines aim to enhance security during the event.
